label: lem:feynman-trace-collapse
title: Path integral collapses to a finite sum on the eigenbasis
html:
Lemma. Path integral collapses to a finite sum on the eigenbasis

Suppose V_{\mathrm{phys}} = \varinjlim V^{\otimes n} admits the complete eigenbasis of (eigenbasis decomposition). Then the Feynman path integral

  \langle\psi_f|\psi_i\rangle
  =
  \int \mathcal{D}\phi\,e^{iS[\phi]/\hbar}

collapses to a finite weighted sum over the irreducible summands V_\lambda \otimes S_\lambda. No regularisation is needed because V^{\otimes n} has finitely many irreducible summands due to the semisimplicity of H_n(R, q) at non-root-of-unity q.
